title: Founder idea
description: One idea of a person's (people/<person-id>/ideas/<id>.json, EE-114), owned by the person, not a venture. It exists before any venture and outlives one; a venture cites the idea it grew from. The text is the person's, verbatim; an agent never rewrites it. Ideas under founders/<handle>/ideas/ still validate until the founders folder moves (not built yet). Its relations and scope are checked through the EE-095 term engine (term typed-link): node packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/frameworks/idea-map/graph.mjs check <ideas folder>.

text.description: The idea in its owner's own words

source.description: Where it was said: a conversation, a note, a voice memo

status.description: in-venture = a venture grew from it; dropped needs a note

importance.description: How much the idea matters to its owner's work, on an ordinal scale. A model may propose it; a person settles it

ventures.description: Venture folders that cite this idea

relations.description: Typed relations to other ideas in the same ideas folder. packages/naive/src/terms/relations.ts maps each name to SKOS, PROV-O, DCMI Terms, AIF and IBIS

to.description: The id of another idea in the same ideas folder

scope.description: The one scope the idea attaches to, and how
A name@function scope in packages/naive/src/terms/ontology-catalog.json, or shared. A scope the idea creates may not be listed yet

relation.description: How this idea relates to the one it names: broader, narrower and related (SKOS), part-of and derived-from (preserved PR 157), builds-on (the idea graph), supports and contradicts (AIF, IBIS). The idea relations in packages/naive/src/terms/relations.ts, which packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/frameworks/idea-map/test.mjs keeps equal to this list

attachment.description: How the idea attaches to its scope. The scope attachments in packages/naive/src/terms/relations.ts, which packages/naive/src/functions/strategy/frameworks/idea-map/test.mjs keeps equal to this list
